volumes.title: 1878 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 1, 1878, Jan. 1-Dec. 31
volumes.blurb: A Harvard student’s year: classes, clubs and hunting, the death of his father in February, and the autumn he first met Alice Hathaway Lee.

volumes.title: 1879 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 2, 1879, Jan. 1-Dec. 31
volumes.blurb: His last full year at Harvard, filled with study, sport and the courtship of Alice Lee.

volumes.title: 1880 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 3, 1880, Jan. 1-Dec. 31
volumes.blurb: Engaged to Alice in January, graduated from Harvard in June, married on his twenty-second birthday, October 27.

volumes.title: 1881 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 4, 1881, Jan. 1-Dec. 26
volumes.blurb: Law school, a long wedding trip to Europe, and his first election, to the New York State Assembly.

volumes.title: 1882 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 5, 1882, Jan. 1-Feb. 15
volumes.blurb: Six weeks in Albany at the start of his first term in the Assembly.

volumes.title: 1883 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 6, 1883, Jan. 1-Oct. 4
volumes.blurb: Brief January entries. Later in the book, over the printed August–October dates, Roosevelt kept the log of his 1884 hunting trip to the Bighorn Mountains.

volumes.title: 1884 diary
volumes.loc_title: Theodore Roosevelt Papers: Series 8: Personal Diaries, 1878-1884; Vol. 7, 1884, Feb. 14-Dec. 17
volumes.blurb: The diary of February 14, 1884, and the year he went west to the Badlands. On view at the Library.
